messages:
maria: Quick idea 10-part pilot (2 weeks) to validate partner onboarding friction and earliest ask signal. $400 stipend each. Short ask, fast feedback. Who volunteers to run this?

kevin: I can run recruitment. Proposed band: mix of small startups (AI-native) + 2 mid-market teams. Screening: monthly inference >100k or active infra experiments.

olga: Suggest we focus on two flows: generation + embeddings. Need a one-page onboarding playbook (runbook + smoke test). I can draft the runbook.

sam: Telemetry: let's capture `dp_experiment=fastpilot_v1`, and tag requests with `flow=gen|embed`. I'll create a lightweight dashboard with activation rate and median time-to-first-response.

maria: Nice. Quick success criteria proposal: 1) 60% onboarding completion within 48h, 2) at least 2 reproducible product requests across partners, 3) partner willingness to extend pilot -> boolean.

legal-bot: Heads up: stipend payments must go through ops policy. We need DP NDA + stipend addendum. Legal can provide short template.

ops: Ops: payment workflow OK but need invoice or payment recipient info. Suggest we collect preferred payment method in screening sheet.

kevin: Draft outreach text (short):
```
Subject: 2-week Redwood pilot (compensated)
Hi <name>,
Would you try a focused 2-week flow and give candid feedback? We9ll pay $400. Onboard Wed, quick check Thurs, final sync week 2. Interested?
Best, Kevin
```

olga: Screening questions (two variants): short & detailed. Short: 1) monthly inference volume? 2) primary flow (generate/embed)? 3) main contact. Detailed variant adds: infra (self-hosted/hosted), SDKs used, runway for 2-week windows.

sam: I'll provide a curl-based smoke script to include in onboarding: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}'` plus embed example.

maria: Ops + Legal: please share NDA/stipend template links here. Kevin + Olga: compile shortlist in sheet https://redwood.company/sheets/fastpilot-v1 (add `recruit:fastpilot_v1` tag).

legal-bot: NDA template: https://redwood.company/drive/short-dp-nda. Stipend addendum: https://redwood.company/drive/stipend-addendum.

ops: We'll need nominee column in sheet and payment instructions. We can approve payments after receipt of signed NDA.

kevin: I'll send invites Tues. Plan: onboard Wed -> smoke test Thurs -> mid-check Thu/Day3 -> final debrief wk2.

olga: For onboarding runbook I'll include quick troubleshooting: token scopes, CORS note, sample SDK snippets, and expected failure modes. Will post draft here.

sam: Dashboard link will be `/dash/experiments/fastpilot_v1`. Posting when live. Will include activation_rate, median_latency, and `first_action_time` histogram.

maria: Agreement: keep commitment minimal, prioritize speed over breadth. If activation <40% on day 3 we pause and iterate on copy/runbook. Updating the sheet now.

kevin: I'll A/B test two email variants (short vs detailed) and report which converts better by Thu EOD.

olga: Adding a quick checklist for partner success: 1) signed NDA, 2) token issued, 3) smoke test passed, 4) scheduled final sync.

maria: Great. Check back in this thread tomorrow with shortlist. :seedling:
